steps.label: Lookup redirected correctly
steps.sub: no-match rows routed to a review table, exactly as designed

steps.label: ...but the review table was broken
steps.sub: a schema mismatch made every write to it fail

steps.label: ...silently
steps.sub: FailParentOnError was left at its default of False

eyebrow: The fix: make the error path fail loudly too
code:
ALTER TABLE stg.dim_product_unmatched
ADD error_description NVARCHAR(1000) NULL;

-- On the OLE DB Destination writing to that table:
FailParentOnError = True
caption: A safeguard that can fail silently isn't a safeguard.
